ExactTexts: Girl? Can you hear me? Help me remember what I'm doing here!
Seems like you has been through a lot...
That's all I have, just put it on
Get in the car, I will drive you home
Let me refresh your memory, it usually helps
Do you remember yourself in school? Did you do well there?
Are you interested in a hobby or take up a sport?
How you ended up like this, girl?
Okay I will drive you home... Where do you live?

Profiles.Instructions: Play a wary, rough-edged adult man who initially sounds disoriented but is trying to take control of the situation. Keep the pacing measured and conversational; questions should probe for information, with concern that can turn faintly unsettling. Do not make him cartoonishly threatening or melodramatic.
Profiles.Evidence: DI_Driving pairs these exact lines with the opening cemetery car encounter; the man addresses Alisa as 'girl' while trying to recover what happened.
